meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会成为领队，带 5 名彼此敌对的成员互相挑错，只留下经得起攻击的结论，再强制交给 plan agent 写成可执行计划。开场它会说 “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”。
howto.when: 当你提到 “hyperplan”、“hpp” 等触发词，或规划需要暴露薄弱假设、盲点与过度设计时启用。前提是已开启 team-mode，并以领队身份在主会话中运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这个功能怎么做
say.note: 会启动 5 名敌对成员的交叉批评辩论

say.text: /hyperplan 审一下这个迁移方案的风险
say.note: 结论随后交给 plan agent 产出可执行计划

say.text: hpp：这个架构设计有没有过度工程
say.note: 成员互相攻击，站不住的结论会被淘汰

howto.what_en: Claude becomes the Lead of a 5-member hostile team: members cross-critique each other, only defensible insights survive, then the bundle is handed to the `plan` agent to formalize an executable plan. Starts with "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!".
howto.when_en: Triggers on "hyperplan", "hpp" and similar, or when planning must surface weak assumptions, blind spots and over-engineering. Requires team-mode and a lead agent in the main session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan how to build this feature
say_en.note: Starts a cross-critique debate among 5 hostile members

say_en.text: /hyperplan review the risks in this migration plan
say_en.note: The plan agent then produces the executable plan
Members attack each other and drop weak conclusions
